items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: We were making the picture, yeah, and we were doing the recording on it.

ctx.x: Paul Newman was the star of this Murray McEachern film, playing the role of a trombone player and Marin Mcgeford did the soundtrack of what Paul Newman was supposed to play.
I do believe I remember something like that. I remember that trombone player -- what was his name?
